chronology.notes: No C-14 dates, varved. depths are varve counts. Dates from varve counts. Age bounds for application of the model: top = 0; bottom = 690.
varve calendar years converted to C14 dates for 5 points including TOP (using Table 1-A in Stuiver and Pearson 1986, Radiocarbon 28(2B):805).

Goring, S., Dawson, A., & Williams, J.W. (in prep) Improving age models and uncertainty estimates in macro-scale paleoecological synthesis.
